name: File explorer
desc: A file window driven entirely by rules: where it went, what was picked, what was opened and what was dropped on it are all events it raises, and go up, go back, show a folder, sort by size and show only what matches are all rule verbs. Counting what is picked is a flowchart on the Steps tab -- a repeat with a branch in it.
vars:
where = ""
chosen = 0
opened = ""
filter = ""
folders = 0
documents = 0
said <- (chosen ? chosen " selected" : "Nothing selected")
counted <- (folders || documents ? folders " folder" (folders = 1 ? "" : "s") " and " documents " file" (documents = 1 ? "" : "s") : "")
anything <- (chosen > 0)

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Files
windows.status:
msg | Double-click a folder to go in; Backspace comes out | grow icon=EC50
where |  | right dim
windows.flows:
; --- what the explorer tells us. `path`, `items`, `item` and `paths`
; --- are the event's own names; = means worked out rather than said.
files WentTo -> assign where =path
files WentTo -> status where =path
files Picked -> assign chosen =items.Length
files Opened -> assign opened =item.Name
files Opened -> status msg =("Opened " item.Name)
files Dropped -> status msg =(paths.Length " dropped on " onto.Name)
files ModeChanged -> status msg =("Showing " viewMode)
; --- and what we tell it
upBtn Click -> goup files
backBtn Click -> goback files
fwdBtn Click -> goforward files
homeBtn Click -> goto files %A_MyDocuments%
deskBtn Click -> goto files %A_Desktop%
refreshBtn Click -> refresh files
iconsBtn Click -> viewmode files icons
listBtn Click -> viewmode files details
bigBtn Click -> viewsort files size -1
allBtn Click -> pickall files
filterBox Change -> viewfilter files {filterBox}
windows.binds:
filterBox <-> filter
sumLabel.Text <- said
countLabel.Text <- counted
countBtn.Enabled <- anything
windows.script:
; Nothing is wired by hand any more: the explorer's own events are rules
; on the Logic tab, and what the window says about itself is worked out
; from the values. The one handler is Count what is picked, and it is
; written in step shapes so it opens as a flowchart.
;
; The same window over something else entirely -- nothing below the
; source changes, because the view never asks what kind of thing it is:
;   files.Component.State.SetSource(AxFileZip(A_Desktop "\theme.zip"))
;   files.Component.State.SetSource(AxFileReg())

kids.name: tip
kids.arg: The explorer raises its own events, so all of this is rules on the Logic tab: where it went, what was picked, what was opened, what was dropped on it. The buttons drive it back the same way -- go up, go back, show a folder, sort by size, show only what matches. The one handler left is a flowchart on the Steps tab: a repeat with a branch in it.
